precondition: Test build of frontend + backend; participant, Organizer and administrator accounts supplied by QA lead; Approved and Published meetings; mailboxes for the invitees; Chrome and a second browser profile for the two-user cases.

cases.description: Verify the bell shows the unread count and opens the notification panel.
procedure: Go to /calendar after signing in.
Look at the bell at the bottom of the sidebar, then click it.
expected: GET /api/notifications/unread-count answers 200; the bell shows a badge "3" and its label reads "Thông báo, 3 chưa đọc".
The panel opens with the title "Thông báo" and the chip "3 mới"; rows are newest first, unread rows are tinted with a dot.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as a participant with 25 notifications, 3 of them unread, created by publishing meetings that invite that account.

cases.description: Verify the badge caps at 99+ when more than 99 notifications are unread.
procedure: Sign in as an account with 120 unread notifications.
Look at the bell, then open the panel.
expected: The badge shows "99+".
The panel title chip reads "99+ mới".
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Account with 120 unread notifications, supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify each row shows its title, body, relative time and the exact time on hover.
procedure: Open the panel.
Look at the first row and hover its time.
expected: The row shows a kind icon, the title (for example "Bạn được mời họp"), the body and a relative time such as "5 phút trước".
Hovering the time shows the full date and time as a tooltip.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as a participant with 25 notifications, 3 of them unread, created by publishing meetings that invite that account.

cases.description: Verify the panel loads older notifications with the paging button.
procedure: Open the panel (20 rows load).
Scroll to the foot and click "Xem thông báo cũ hơn".
expected: GET /api/notifications?page=2&pageSize=20 answers 200; the button shows "Đang tải…" and then 5 more rows are appended without repeats.
The button disappears once the last page is loaded.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as a participant with 25 notifications, 3 of them unread, created by publishing meetings that invite that account.

cases.description: Verify the empty panel for an account with no notification.
procedure: Sign in as an account that has never been invited.
Open the panel.
expected: The panel shows "Chưa có thông báo nào" and "Lời mời họp và nhắc lịch họp sẽ hiện ở đây.".
"Đánh dấu tất cả đã đọc" is disabled and the bell shows no badge.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Active account with no notification, supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify the panel shows the backend message with a retry when the list cannot load.
procedure: Stop the backend database (QA lead) and open the panel for the first time.
Restore the database and click "Thử lại".
expected: Backend answers 500 with MSG40; the panel shows "Không thể tải thông báo. Vui lòng thử lại." and a "Thử lại" button.
After "Thử lại" succeeds the list appears.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as a participant; the QA lead can interrupt the database.

cases.description: Verify a failed refresh keeps the list already on screen.
procedure: Open the panel so the list loads, close it.
Interrupt the database (QA lead), reopen the panel.
expected: The earlier rows stay visible; one line "Không làm mới được danh sách." with a "Thử lại" link shows above them.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as a participant with 25 notifications, 3 of them unread, created by publishing meetings that invite that account.
The QA lead can interrupt the database on request.

cases.description: Verify the panel closes on Escape, on an outside click and keeps the page usable while open.
procedure: Open the panel.
Click a button on the page behind it.
Open the panel again and press Escape.
Open it again and click outside it.
expected: The panel is non-modal: the page behind still reacts.
Escape closes the panel and the focus returns to the bell; an outside click closes it too.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as a participant with 25 notifications, 3 of them unread, created by publishing meetings that invite that account.

cases.description: Verify the panel fits a phone screen.
procedure: Resize the browser to 390px wide (touch emulation) and open the panel.
expected: The panel spans the full width; "Đánh dấu tất cả đã đọc" shows as "Đọc hết"; the per-row "Đánh dấu đã đọc" check is always visible; the page does not scroll sideways.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as a participant with 25 notifications, 3 of them unread, created by publishing meetings that invite that account.

cases.description: Verify the panel is unreachable when signed out.
procedure: Sign out.
Go to /calendar.
expected: The app redirects to /login; no bell and no panel are rendered, and no request to /api/notifications is sent.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Not signed in.

cases.description: Verify one row is marked read with its check button.
procedure: Open the panel.
Hover an unread row and click its "Đánh dấu đã đọc" check button.
expected: POST /api/notifications/{id}/read answers 200.
The row loses its tint and dot, the check button disappears, the bell badge drops from 3 to 2 and the chip reads "2 mới".
Reload the page: the row is still read and the badge still shows 2.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as a participant with 25 notifications, 3 of them unread, created by publishing meetings that invite that account.

cases.description: Verify all notifications are marked read from the panel.
procedure: Open the panel.
Click "Đánh dấu tất cả đã đọc".
expected: The button shows "Đang đánh dấu…"; POST /api/notifications/read-all answers 200 with markedCount 3.
Every loaded row turns read, the badge disappears and the chip "mới" is gone; the button becomes disabled.
Notifications on pages not yet loaded are read too: after reload and "Xem thông báo cũ hơn" none is tinted.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as a participant with 25 notifications, 3 of them unread, created by publishing meetings that invite that account.

cases.description: Verify "Đánh dấu tất cả đã đọc" is disabled when nothing is unread.
procedure: Sign in as an account whose notifications are all read.
Open the panel and hover the button.
expected: The button is disabled and no request is sent when it is clicked.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Account with notifications that are all read.

cases.description: Verify a failed single mark puts the row back and tells the user.
procedure: Open the panel.
Make the backend refuse the call (QA lead stops the API or the browser goes offline).
Click "Đánh dấu đã đọc" on an unread row.
expected: The row first turns read, then returns to unread, the badge returns to its earlier number and a red toast shows the error message from the backend or the network.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as a participant with 25 notifications, 3 of them unread, created by publishing meetings that invite that account.
The QA lead can interrupt the API on request.

cases.description: Verify marking is per account.
procedure: In browser A sign in as participant A and click "Đánh dấu tất cả đã đọc".
In browser B sign in as participant B and open the panel.
expected: Participant B's rows and badge are unchanged.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Two participants with unread notifications, supplied by QA lead; two browser profiles.

cases.description: Verify the second tab follows after the count is re-read.
procedure: Open the app in two tabs as the same account.
In tab 1 click "Đánh dấu tất cả đã đọc".
Switch to tab 2 and open the panel.
expected: Tab 2 reads page 1 again on opening and shows every row read with no badge.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as a participant with 25 notifications, 3 of them unread, created by publishing meetings that invite that account.

cases.description: Verify clicking a meeting notification opens the meeting and marks it read.
procedure: Open the panel.
Click the unread row "Bạn được mời họp".
expected: GET /api/notifications/{id}/target answers 200 with url /mgmt/meetings/<meetingId> and POST .../read answers 200.
The panel closes, the browser goes to /mgmt/meetings/<meetingId> showing the meeting detail, and the bell badge is one lower.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as a participant of a Published meeting with an unread invitation notification.

cases.description: Verify a meeting the user may no longer read shows the unavailable toast.
procedure: Open the panel (the notification is listed).
The Organizer removes the user from the meeting in another browser.
Click the notification.
expected: GET /api/notifications/{id}/target answers 404; a red toast reads "Thông báo này không còn khả dụng.".
The panel stays open on the same page and the notification is still marked read.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Participant with an invitation notification; an Organizer in a second browser.

cases.description: Verify a calendar-share notification opens the sharing page on that share.
procedure: Sign in as the owner of a calendar who received a share request.
Open the panel and click the notification.
expected: The browser goes to /calendar/sharing?share=<shareId> and the share is shown on the sharing page.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
A pending calendar share request for the signed-in account (SCRUM-142).

cases.description: Verify opening a notification for the page the user is already on does not stack history.
procedure: Open the meeting from the panel.
Open the panel again and click another notification of the same meeting.
Press Back once.
expected: The URL stays /mgmt/meetings/<meetingId> and the page re-reads its data.
Back returns to the page before the meeting, not to a duplicate entry.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Two notifications about the same meeting for the signed-in participant.

cases.description: Verify an already read notification opens without another read request.
procedure: Open the panel and click a row that is already read.
expected: Only GET /api/notifications/{id}/target is sent; no POST .../read; the browser goes to the meeting.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as a participant with 25 notifications, 3 of them unread, created by publishing meetings that invite that account.

cases.description: Verify a failed read does not block the way to the meeting.
procedure: Make POST /api/notifications/{id}/read fail (QA lead blocks it), keep GET .../target working.
Click an unread notification.
expected: The browser still goes to the meeting; the row is back to unread when the panel is reopened.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as a participant with 25 notifications, 3 of them unread, created by publishing meetings that invite that account.
The QA lead can block the read call on request.

cases.description: Verify a new notification shows a toast and updates the badge while the panel is closed.
procedure: In browser A keep the app open on /calendar as a participant.
In browser B the Organizer publishes a meeting inviting that participant.
expected: Browser A shows an info toast "Bạn được mời họp — Bạn được mời tham dự cuộc họp ...", the bell rings and the badge goes up by one without any reload.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Participant account and Organizer account supplied by QA lead; an Approved meeting; two browser profiles.

cases.description: Verify a new notification appears at the top of an open panel without a toast.
procedure: In browser A open the panel as a participant.
In browser B the Organizer publishes another meeting inviting that participant.
expected: The new row appears at the top of the list, tinted as unread, and the chip count rises; no toast is shown.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Same setup as the previous case.

cases.description: Verify the same notification pushed twice is shown once.
procedure: Keep the app open and trigger a notification.
Drop and restore the network so the hub reconnects.
expected: The list contains the notification once and the badge counts it once.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as a participant with 25 notifications, 3 of them unread, created by publishing meetings that invite that account.

cases.description: Verify the count and list are re-read after the connection returns.
procedure: Open the panel as a participant.
Take the browser offline for 30 seconds while the Organizer publishes a meeting.
Bring the browser back online.
expected: Without a reload, the badge and the top of the list include the notification that was published while offline.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Participant and Organizer accounts; two browser profiles.

cases.description: Verify the person who acts does not receive a notification for their own action.
procedure: As the Organizer publish a meeting that the Organizer also takes part in.
Open the Organizer's panel.
expected: No "Bạn được mời họp" notification for that meeting is listed for the Organizer; other invitees receive theirs.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Organizer who is also on the roster of an Approved meeting; another participant.

cases.description: Verify a change of role shows the access-updated toast.
procedure: Stay signed in as a user in browser A.
In browser B an administrator changes that user's role.
expected: Browser A shows an info toast "Quyền truy cập của bạn vừa được cập nhật." and the menus follow the new role without signing in again.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Account and administrator supplied by QA lead; two browser profiles.

cases.description: Verify publishing a meeting sends an invitation email to the invitee.
procedure: As the Organizer click "Công bố" on an Approved meeting that has a participant with a reachable inbox and confirm "Công bố" in the dialog "Công bố cuộc họp".
Open the participant's inbox.
expected: An email with the subject of the invitation arrives, titled "Lời mời tham dự cuộc họp", with the meeting information, the link /mgmt/meetings/<id> and the attachment thu-moi-hop.ics.
The publish request itself does not wait for the mail.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Approved meeting; Organizer; a participant mailbox supplied by QA lead; email transport enabled on the test build.

cases.description: Verify the Organizer who publishes also gets the invitation email but no bell notification.
procedure: As the Organizer who is also a participant, publish the meeting.
Check the Organizer's inbox and the panel.
expected: The inbox holds the invitation email; the panel holds no "Bạn được mời họp" for that meeting.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Organizer on the roster of an Approved meeting; a mailbox for the Organizer.

cases.description: Verify a reschedule sends the "Cuộc họp đã dời lịch" email to every participant.
procedure: As the Organizer move a Published meeting to a new time.
Open the inboxes of the participants.
expected: Each participant receives "Cuộc họp đã dời lịch" with the old time struck through beside the new one.
Each participant except the Organizer also gets a bell notification.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Published meeting with two participants with mailboxes; Organizer.

cases.description: Verify cancelling a meeting sends the cancellation email without a way in.
procedure: As the Organizer cancel a Published meeting with a reason.
Open an invitee's inbox.
expected: The email "Cuộc họp đã bị huỷ" arrives with the cancel calendar attachment huy-hop.ics and no link into the meeting.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Published meeting with a participant mailbox; Organizer.

cases.description: Verify a reminder email goes out about 15 minutes before the start.
procedure: Publish a meeting that starts in about 14 minutes.
Wait for the reminder cycle and open the invitee's inbox and panel.
expected: The email "Cuộc họp sắp bắt đầu" arrives and the panel shows the notification "Cuộc họp sắp bắt đầu" with "Cuộc họp "<title>" sẽ bắt đầu trong vòng 15 phút.".
Each is sent once: waiting another cycle adds nothing.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
A Published meeting starting within 15 minutes; participant with a mailbox.

cases.description: Verify a participant added after the reminder window opens is not emailed twice.
procedure: Publish a meeting that starts in 10 minutes inviting participant A.
Add participant B to the roster and wait for the reminder cycle.
expected: B receives the invitation email and the bell reminder, but no separate "Cuộc họp sắp bắt đầu" email.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Published meeting starting in about 10 minutes; Organizer; two participant mailboxes.

cases.description: Verify no email is sent for a draft or unpublished meeting.
procedure: As the Organizer create a meeting and add a participant but do not publish.
Check the participant's inbox after a few minutes.
expected: No invitation email arrives.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Organizer; participant mailbox.
